It was the first such collapse in over a decade); and Mark Carney brings Trump impersonator onstage to joke about U.S.-Canada ties (The Trump impersonator appeared at an annual press dinner where the Canadian prime minister typically delivers a roast). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. headlines.title: Kremlin says trilateral talks on Ukraine may take place in Abu Dhabi

headlines.title: US eyes lasting agreement to end Iran war
headlines.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Saturday he wanted a permanent deal to end the war with Iran and prevent future administrations from allowing Tehran to have a nuclear weapon, amid reports that Israel and the US were considering launching a new assault on Iran.

headlines.title: Trump says he had very good discussions with Putin
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON/KYIV — US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he and Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin held very good talks on Ukraine during their meeting in China, but said he did not want to discuss security guarantees for Ukraine without a deal.

headlines.title: Kenya, DR Congo agree to fully restore diplomatic ties
headlines.summary: BRAZZAVILLE -- Kenyan President William Ruto and his Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) counterpart Felix Tshisekedi agreed Sunday to work toward fully restoring diplomatic relations, according to statements posted by each leader.

hackerNews.summary: The recent proof of the Riemann hypothesis came with a statistic attached: the proof is 17 million lines of Lean. Beyond the philosophical questions of what it means to have a proof longer than any human could comprehend, I’m left with a simpler question: is that as large as it sounds? To investigate, I hunted for collections of Lean proofs online. I found two and charted the lengths of their proofs.
